body:
Adds JavaScript AI controllers and map scripts for trusted developer code, with a JavaScript option in the scenario editor. Embedded scripts execute automatically. Restricted capabilities, pinned math and resource limits support reliability and deterministic execution; they do not protect against malicious scripts.

Both AI and map scripts use ordinary top-level variables and a synchronous `step(ctx)` or `main(ctx)`. The engine retains each runtime between callbacks and snapshots supported globals for save/load and transactional rollback. Plain objects and arrays preserve aliases, cycles, sparse entries, property attributes, undefined, signed zero and non-finite values. Functions are recreated from source on load. Private closure state, class/opaque objects, accessors and function-owned data cannot persist and fail explicitly. The [guide](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/master/docs/development/javascript.md), [API](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/blob/master/docs/development/javascript-api.md), declarations and examples describe these limits together.

The scenario editor offers JavaScript alongside SGSL and USL, with a minimal callback, `.js` loading/saving, automatic detection of embedded JavaScript, and syntax checking through Compile/F9. Separate language drafts survive switching; OK validates and commits the selected source/mode, while Cancel preserves the committed script. JavaScript mode suppresses legacy script execution and presentation without discarding the serialized legacy payload.

The technical review and improvement pass covered runtime ownership, engine integration, determinism, UI, documentation and tests. Corrections include generation identities throughout conversion/reuse/save-load, pinned OpenLibm `Math.hypot`, canonical persistent NaNs, transactional globals/RNG/orders/effects, fatal-session diagnostics/termination, localized one-time messages and presentation restoration, atomic editor replacement, scoped QuickJS ownership, strict corpus/provenance checks and Windows test environment handling. Observation history remains independent world data. QuickJS-NG and OpenLibm are pinned with reconstructible local patch series and a vendor verification command; scripting-object checks reject unexpected platform math dependencies. This was a review for trusted code, not a comprehensive hostile-code security audit.

The integration preserves master's graphics settings, touch controls, experiments, rendering improvements and map-image CLI. Master had already released the experiment header as save format124, so scripting writes125 and network/YOG protocol48. Minimum save version58 and replay minimum123 remain intact. Legacy124 saves receive identities through version-gated loading;125 saves preserve and validate stored identities/counters. Scripting profile1 remains unpublished. Its draft fixtures were migrated without changing prior team/entity records or numerical goldens. Existing non-JavaScript pacing and balance are intended to remain unchanged; playing the optional AI/scenarios remains part of maintainer review.

Validation retains exact source identities:

- The completed scripting matrix is `8a25c2bd2440e99246171967a31c68dc15917f95` (canonical SHA256 `1540813995310acf88924c167bbb9c80525eb9d5cd7fe4a421d8e7ee5b49a991`). Its 21 unit and33 engine cases produce60 comparable artifacts agreeing across macOS ARM64/Rosetta x86-64, Linux GCC13/GCC15/Clang18, Chromium/Firefox/WebKit, Android x86-64 Emulator, iOS ARM64 Simulator and four native CI compiler lanes.
- Both256-tick JavaScript fixtures execute actual AI callbacks, realistic map queries/calculations, one/four workers and six save/resume boundaries. All72 compared Mac checksum/replay/save outputs agree. Released traces, legacy saves/version boundaries and genuine upstream124 fresh/resumed baselines pass.
- Combined source `53d16aa37` passed82 selected native cases, including15 editor/presentation cases and actual graphics/settings tests, plus three WebGL reload/recovery cases and six cross-browser corpus/baseline cases. All browsers strictly agree on60 artifacts; four hosted native corpora also agree. Its full downstream CI remained incomplete when master advanced.
- Later combined source `121c6adb6` passed all hosted build jobs, four native scripting corpora, macOS candidate and all three Android ABI builds, including x64 APK smoke. It also passed103 build-system and36 tooling regressions, translations and both iOS dependency-selection paths. Its WebAssembly producer was correctly rejected as dirty because upstream's isolated SDK installer generated `tools/.glob2-locks/`. The final follow-up narrowly ignores that generated directory and adds a production-lease/provenance regression: all nine provenance tests pass, and unrelated new source remains detected.

[Evidence](https://github.com/Globulation2/glob2/tree/codex/javascript-globals-evidence/final-review-8a25c2bd2) retains source bundles, individual hashes, commands, compiler/configuration, numeric results, traces, saves/replays, screenshots and logs. Earlier executions are not relabelled as later revisions. Only the20-byte MapHeader SHA1 is excluded from decoded cross-platform save comparisons. Same-platform raw save/replay equality is tested. Released Castor already reconstructs unpersisted scheduling after load; fresh/resumed results match the respective upstream baselines, while JavaScript continuation requires exact uninterrupted/resumed agreement. The earlier WebGL batching failure and the dirty producer are retained rather than claimed as successful runs.

Physical Android reruns, physical iOS/signing and the designated Windows Vagrant execution remain unavailable. Builds, Simulator and hosted Windows results do not substitute for those gates. Latest remote121 execution became unverified when the Mac left the home LAN. No store publication occurred. The technical reviewers acted for the author.

Merged at the maintainer's explicit instruction without another rebase or full CI cycle. Final head `9903f6712ba0b23c4596d7072af18b48b2177457` differs from121 only in the generated-file ignore and its regression; squash commit `0cadfa23b916fe381f6a600ef38fb293981196a0` has the identical Git tree. Remaining CI continues on master; full final-revision/physical acceptance is not claimed.
title: Add deterministic JavaScript foundation for AI and map scripts
